# charbi-font
> A Chinese font subsetting tool that scans source code and produces a smaller font package.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/charbi-font/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/charbi-font
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
